front.title: Template-Driven HTTP CONNECT Proxying for TCP

abstract.t: TCP tunneling using HTTP CONNECT has long been part of the core HTTP specification. However, this tunneling functionality has several important deficiencies due to the lack of a well-defined HTTP origin or path. This specification defines an alternative HTTP proxy service configuration for TCP connections. This configuration is described by a URI Template, similar to the CONNECT-UDP and CONNECT- IP protocols.
